summary: Two findings: one medium-severity style nit on the verify-findings short-circuit in src/cli/run.ts, and one high-severity leak on a hard-coded API key inside the diff. The leak survived suppression because high-confidence secrets always bypass minimum-severity filtering (see docs/security.md). One low-severity style finding was suppressed for not meeting the medium threshold.

comments.body:
When the operator passes `--no-verify-findings`, `requestLiveReview` still calls `parseDiffPositions` on the model output. The result is that off-diff citations get silently dropped even when the operator asked for them. Either honor `--no-verify-findings` end-to-end (skip `parseDiffPositions` too) or document the current behavior in `--help`. The current shape is surprising.

Repro: `umactually --no-verify-findings --api-url https://api.example.com/v1 --api-key <redacted>`. Inspect the inline thread count vs the model-reported count in `artifacts/manual/s1-github-self-review.md`.

High-confidence secret leak: `const FALLBACK_TOKEN = "sk-cp-DO-NOT-LEAK-DEMO-FIXTURE-0000";`. This is a credential embedded in source. Rotate immediately, purge from git history with `git filter-repo`, and replace with a runtime read from an env var (e.g. `process.env.UMACTUALLY_API_KEY`). See docs/security.md#secret-leak-detection for the bypass-severity guarantee.
